paragraphs.text: Jess Lebow is an American editor and fantasy writer. He edited and wrote several books and stories for Magic: The Gathering .

Lebow was an editor for Wizards of the Coast 's Book Publishing department from 1998 to 2002. In this capacity, he scheduled, managed, and budgeted for two full-scale book lines. Under the shared pseudonym of T.H. Lain, he also wrote for Dungeons & Dragons .
